name: TC-09-safety-permit-lifecycle
description: TC-09.1: Safety Permit Full Lifecycle — Draft → Requested → Approved → Active → Expired, plus permit types

doc_metadata.title: TC-09.1 — Safety Permit List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Safety Permit. Safety permits ensure proper authorization before hazardous maintenance tasks. Permit types include LOTO, Hot Work, Confined Space, Excavation, Working at Height, and Electrical.

doc_metadata.title: TC-09.1 — Safety Permit Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The safety permit list shows all permits with their type, status, valid dates, and linked work orders. Color-coded status badges indicate the current lifecycle state.

doc_metadata.title: TC-09.1 — New Safety Permit Form
doc_metadata.caption: The safety permit form includes fields for permit type, work order link, hazards identified, precautions required, PPE requirements, and emergency contact information.

steps.value: E2E Lifecycle Test — Electrical hazard, arc flash risk

doc_metadata.title: TC-09.1 — Fill Hazards Identified
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Lifecycle Test — Electrical hazard, " into the Hazards Identified field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-09.1 — Permit Created (Draft)
doc_metadata.caption: The safety permit is created in 'Draft' state. The workflow progresses: Draft → Submit Request → Requested → Approve → Approved → Activate → Active → Expire → Expired → Renew → Draft.

doc_metadata.title: TC-09.1 — Safety Permit Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The safety permit detail page shows all safety-related fields, the workflow state badge, and available transition actions. The permit must be approved by a safety officer before activation.
